requirements.text: 8+ years building and operating production systems
Several years in a technical leadership role (Staff, Lead, Principal or equivalent)
Track record of designing and evolving the architecture of a product that scaled in users, data and team size
Deep backend expertise: data modelling, API design, distributed systems, integrations
Has led technical decisions across team boundaries with clear written design docs
Experience making product and business trade-offs together with founders or senior leadership
Has mentored senior engineers and shaped hiring
Experience shipping LLM-based features to production
Degree in computer science or a related field, or an equivalent track record
Valid work permit for Germany and readiness to work on-site in Munich
Experience with systems in regulated domains (fintech, accounting, tax, payroll, insurance)
LLM evaluation, RAG or agentic workflows at production scale

resumes.text:
Lena Marsh
Staff Software Engineer, Munich

Summary
Engineer with nine years of building and operating production systems in B2B SaaS. The last four years in technical leadership, shaping architecture for products that grew from thousands to millions of users. Backend background covering data modelling, API design, distributed systems and integrations. Writes design documents, mentors senior engineers and works closely with founders on product strategy.

Experience
Staff Software Engineer, Halvard Software GmbH, Berlin (2022 to present)
- Lead architect for a collaboration platform for construction teams. Monthly users grew from 40,000 to 2.5 million and engineering teams grew from 3 to 14.
- Re-designed the data layer and API gateway, moving a monolith into domain services over 18 months with no customer downtime.
- Wrote design documents for the event-streaming migration. Six teams outside my own adopted the standards.
- Partnered with the CEO and CFO on pricing tiers and the 2024 roadmap, weighing build speed against margin.
- Mentored eight senior engineers, sat on every senior hiring panel and rewrote the interview rubric.
- Shipped LLM-based document summarisation features to production, including prompt versioning and output monitoring.

Senior Software Engineer, Quellstein Labs, Hamburg (2018 to 2022)
- Built REST APIs and integrations with CRM and calendar providers, using TypeScript and Node.js on the backend.
- Owned PostgreSQL data modelling for the workflow engine. Query tuning halved p95 latency.
- Set the API versioning practice across three product teams.

Software Engineer, Tessera GmbH, Leipzig (2015 to 2018)
- Maintained Java services and internal tooling.

Education
M.Sc. Computer Science, Technical University of Hamburg, 2015

Skills
TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Next.js, distributed systems, API design, prompt engineering

Languages and eligibility
English: C1 certified (Cambridge Advanced). German: native.
Valid German residence permit with unrestricted work authorisation. Based in Munich and happy to work on-site.

Tomasz Krol
Lead Engineer, Frankfurt

Summary
Software engineer with six years of production experience, the last two as a Lead Engineer on a logistics product. Comfortable designing services and schemas, and used to agreeing scope with business stakeholders. Backend experience in Python and Go.

Experience
Lead Engineer, Routewise GmbH, Frankfurt (2023 to present)
- Lead engineer for the shipment-tracking product, with a team of five.
- Split the monolith into three services, now handling 3 million tracked shipments per month.
- Designed REST endpoints and database schemas for the tracking service.
- Ran architecture review meetings across three teams and wrote a decision record for each outcome.
- Agreed delivery scope and trade-offs with the COO every quarter.

Software Engineer, Kaltwerk Systems, Stuttgart (2018 to 2023)
- Developed Python services for warehouse scheduling and Go-based data collectors.
- Built a demand forecast model with scikit-learn for the planning team.
- Wrote unit tests for the Python services.

Education
B.Sc. Information Technology, University of Applied Sciences Esslingen, 2018

Skills
Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Docker, REST design, scikit-learn

Languages
English: fluent, C1 certified. German: native.

Marco Feld
Operations Manager, Munich

Summary
Operations manager with twelve years in hospitality and live events in Munich. Strong at scheduling, supplier coordination and budgeting for events of up to 5,000 guests. Known for calm leadership on busy event days and for keeping clients informed from first enquiry to final invoice.

Experience
Operations Manager, Alpenhall Events GmbH, Munich (2019 to present)
- Planned logistics for about 120 events a year, coordinating caterers, venues and technical crews.
- Manage a team of 14 staff, including rosters, shift planning and holiday cover.
- Negotiated supplier contracts and kept event budgets within 5 percent of forecast.
- Run a monthly client review to collect feedback and adjust service standards.

Event Coordinator, Stadtsaal Catering, Augsburg (2013 to 2019)
- Coordinated weddings and corporate dinners for up to 300 guests.
- Trained new front-of-house staff on food safety and service standards.
- Kept a shared planning calendar for six venues.

Education
Bachelor of Arts, Hospitality Management, Hochschule Munich, 2013
Vocational training as a Restaurant Specialist, 2009

Skills
Event planning, budgeting, supplier negotiation, customer service, Excel for rosters and budgets

Languages and eligibility
English: C1 level, certified by the Cambridge exam. German: native.
I hold a valid German work permit with no restrictions and I am based in Munich, available for on-site work.
